data.one_liner: Implements RFC 6901 JSON Pointer for reading, writing and removing values in JSON documents.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart implementation of the JSON Pointer standard (RFC 6901). You can parse or build pointers, then read, write or remove the referenced value in a decoded JSON structure. All operations are pure and return new copies of the document.
use_when: You need to navigate or modify JSON data by pointer paths without adding dependencies
You want a small, test‑covered library that follows the RFC exactly
avoid_when: You require full JSONPath or query capabilities
You need schema validation or complex transformation logic
strengths: Complete RFC 6901 support including the '-' token
weaknesses: Only handles pointer operations, no JSONPath or advanced querying
No code generation or async features
